name: Millo
meaning: A fortification in Jerusalem built by Solomon
notes: Millo (Akra), a fortification in Jerusalem built by Solomon ( 1Ki.9.15, 24; 11:27 ) and repaired by Hezekiah ( 2Ch.32.5 ).

name: Minni
meaning: A kingdom allied with Ararat and Ashkenaz
notes: Minni, a kingdom mentioned alongside Ararat and Ashkenaz, was called to battle against Babylon.

name: Minnith
meaning: An Ammonite town known for its wheat
notes: Minnith, an Ammonite town, was known for its wheat and was a place of defeat for the Ammonites by Jephthah.

name: Misgab
meaning: A Moabite stronghold
notes: Misgab, meaning "fortress," was a stronghold in Moab that faced judgment according to Jeremiah's prophecy.

name: Mishal
meaning: A Levitical city in Asher
notes: Mishal (Mashal), a Levitical city in the territory of Asher ( Joshua 19:26; 21:30; 1Ch.6.74 ).

name: Misrephoth-maim
meaning: A place near Sidon where the Canaanites fled
notes: Misrephoth-maim, a location near Sidon, was where the Canaanites fled after being defeated by Joshua.

name: Mithkah
meaning: An Israelite campsite during the wilderness wanderings
notes: Mithkah was a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey, between Terah and Hashmonah.

name: Mitylene
meaning: A city on the island of Lesbos visited by Paul
notes: Mitylene, a city on the island of Lesbos where Paul's ship stopped on his way to Jerusalem ( Act.20.14 ).

name: Mizar_Mount
meaning: A mountain mentioned in a psalm of lament
notes: Mount Mizar, a mountain mentioned in a psalm of lament, possibly representing a place of remembrance or longing for God's presence ( Psalm 42:6 ).

name: Mizpah
meaning: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment
notes: Mizpah (Mizpeh, Ramah, Ramathaim-zophim, Arimathea), a city in Benjamin where the Israelites gathered for judgment and prayer ( Judges 20:1, 3; 21:1, 5, 8; 1Sa.7.5-7, 11-12, 16; 10:17 ), and the hometown of Samuel ( 1Sa.1.19; 2:11; 7:17; 8:4; 15:34; 16:13; 19:18-23; 20:1; 25:1; 28:3 ) and Joseph of Arimathea ( Matthew 27:57; Mrk.15.43; Luke 23:50-51; Jhn.19.38 ).

name: Mizpeh
meaning: A town in the lowlands of Judah
notes: Mizpeh, a town in the lowlands (Shephelah) of Judah ( Joshua 15:38 ).

name: Mizpeh_Valley
meaning: A region near Mount Hermon
notes: The Valley of Mizpeh (Mizpah), a region near Mount Hermon where Joshua defeated the kings of the northern Canaanite coalition ( Joshua 11:3, 8 ).

name: Moab
meaning: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan
notes: Moab was an ancient kingdom located east of the Dead Sea in present-day Jordan, often in conflict with Israel.

name: Moab_Plains
meaning: Region east of the Jordan River, opposite Jericho
notes: The plains of Moab, located east of the Jordan River and opposite Jericho, were where the Israelites camped before entering the Promised Land ( Num.22.1; 26:3, 63; 31:12; 33:48-50; 35:1; 36:13; Deut 34:1, 8; Josh 13:32 ).

name: Moladah
meaning: Town in the Negev, allotted to Judah and Simeon
notes: Moladah was a town in the Negev region, allotted to the tribes of Judah and Simeon, and later inhabited by the people of Judah after the Babylonian exile ( Josh 15:26; 19:2; 1Ch.4.28; Neh.11.26 ).

name: Moreh
meaning: Place near Shechem; also a hill near Gilgal
notes: Moreh refers to two locations: a place near Shechem where Abraham built an altar ( Gen.12.6 ) and a hill near Gilgal, associated with the blessing and cursing ceremony ( Deut 11:30 ).

name: Moreh
meaning: Place near Shechem; hill where Gideon camped
notes: Moreh refers to a place near Shechem associated with Abraham ( Gen.12.6 ) and a hill where Gideon camped before attacking the Midianites ( Judg 7:1 ).

name: Moresheth
meaning: Hometown of the prophet Micah in Judah
notes: Moresheth was the hometown of the prophet Micah, located in Judah.

name: Moriah_Mount
meaning: Site of Solomon's temple in Jerusalem
notes: Mount Moriah was the site where Solomon built the temple in Jerusalem.

name: Mortar
meaning: A district or valley in or near Jerusalem
notes: The Mortar was a district or valley in or near Jerusalem, mentioned in Zephaniah's prophecy.

name: Moserah
meaning: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings
notes: Moserah was a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings, and where Aaron died and was buried.

name: Moseroth
meaning: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings
notes: Moseroth was a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings after leaving Egypt.

name: Most_Holy_Place
meaning: The innermost room of the tabernacle and temple
notes: The Most Holy Place was the innermost room of the tabernacle and temple, where the Ark of the Covenant was kept.

name: Mozah
meaning: A town in the territory of Benjamin
notes: Mozah was a town allotted to the tribe of Benjamin.

name: Muster_Gate
meaning: A gate in Jerusalem mentioned in Nehemiah's time
notes: The Muster Gate, also known as the Miphkad Gate, was one of the gates of Jerusalem mentioned in Nehemiah's time.

name: Myra
meaning: A city in Lycia where Paul's ship stopped
notes: Myra was a city in Lycia, Asia Minor, where Paul's ship stopped on his journey to Rome as a prisoner.

name: Mysia
meaning: A region in northwest Asia Minor visited by Paul
notes: Mysia was a region in northwest Asia Minor (modern Turkey) that Paul and his companions passed through on his second missionary journey.

name: Naamah
meaning: A town in the Judean lowlands
notes: Naamah was a town in the Judean lowlands, mentioned in the tribal allotment of Judah.

name: Naaran
meaning: A border town between Ephraim and Benjamin
notes: Naaran, also called Naarah, was a border town between the tribes of Ephraim and Benjamin.

name: Nahalol
meaning: A Levitical city in Zebulun
notes: Nahalol, also called Nahalal, was a Levitical city in the territory of Zebulun.

name: Nain
meaning: A town in Galilee where Jesus raised a widow's son
notes: Nain was a town in Galilee where Jesus raised a widow's son from the dead.

name: Naioth
meaning: A place near Ramah where David fled from Saul
notes: Naioth was a place near Ramah where David fled to escape King Saul, and where Samuel and a group of prophets lived.

name: Naphath
meaning: A region in Issachar with Manassite towns
notes: Naphath was a region in Issachar that contained towns belonging to the tribe of Manasseh.

name: Nazareth
meaning: The hometown of Jesus in Galilee
notes: Nazareth was a village in Galilee where Jesus grew up, giving rise to His title "Jesus of Nazareth."

name: Neah
meaning: A border town of Zebulun and Asher
notes: Neah, also called Neiel, was a border town between the territories of Zebulun and Asher.

name: Neapolis
meaning: A port city in Macedonia visited by Paul
notes: Neapolis was a port city in Macedonia where Paul landed on his first journey to Europe.

name: Neballat
meaning: A town in Benjamin inhabited by Benjamites after the exile
notes: Neballat was a town in the territory of Benjamin where some Benjamites settled after returning from the Babylonian exile.

name: Nebo
meaning: A town in Judah, possibly named after a person
notes: Nebo was a town in Judah, possibly named after a person, whose inhabitants returned from the Babylonian exile.

name: Nebo
meaning: A city and mountain in Moab
notes: Nebo was a city and mountain in Moab, mentioned in the Old Testament.

name: Nebo_Mount
meaning: The mountain where Moses viewed the Promised Land
notes: Mount Nebo, also called Abarim, was the mountain from which Moses viewed the Promised Land before his death.

name: Negeb
meaning: The southern region of Israel, a semi-arid area
notes: The Negeb, meaning "south," refers to the semi-arid region in the southern part of Israel.

name: Nephtoah
meaning: A spring on the border of Judah and Benjamin
notes: Nephtoah was a spring that served as a boundary marker between the territories of Judah and Benjamin.

name: Netaim
meaning: A place associated with potters in Judah
notes: Netaim was a place in Judah where potters lived and worked.

name: Netophah
meaning: A town in Judah, home to several notable individuals
notes: Netophah was a town in Judah, known as the hometown of several notable individuals in the Bible.

name: New_Gate
meaning: A gate in Jerusalem during Jeremiah's time
notes: The New Gate was a gate in Jerusalem during the time of the prophet Jeremiah.

name: Nezib
meaning: A town in the Judean lowlands
notes: Nezib was a town allotted to the tribe of Judah in the lowland region.

name: Nibshan
meaning: A town in the Judean wilderness
notes: Nibshan was a town in the wilderness of Judah, mentioned in the list of towns allotted to the tribe of Judah.

name: Nicopolis
meaning: A city in Epirus where Paul planned to winter
notes: Nicopolis was a city in Epirus where Paul intended to spend the winter, as mentioned in his letter to Titus.

name: Nile
meaning: The major river of Egypt, mentioned in various contexts
notes: The Nile, the major river of Egypt, is mentioned in various contexts throughout the Bible, often in relation to the history of Israel and God's judgment on Egypt.

name: Nimrim
meaning: A place in Moab known for its waters
notes: Nimrim was a place in Moab known for its waters, which are mentioned in the context of God's judgment on Moab.

name: Nineveh
meaning: The capital of Assyria, known for its wickedness and repentance
notes: Nineveh, the capital of Assyria, is known in the Bible for its wickedness and its remarkable repentance following Jonah's preaching.

name: Nob
meaning: A city of priests near Jerusalem
notes: Nob was a city of priests near Jerusalem, known for a massacre ordered by King Saul and as a temporary location of the Ark of the Covenant.

name: Nod
meaning: The land where Cain settled after killing Abel
notes: Nod was the land east of Eden where Cain settled after he was banished for killing his brother Abel.

name: Oboth
meaning: A place where the Israelites camped during the Exodus
notes: Oboth was one of the places where the Israelites camped during their journey through the wilderness after the Exodus from Egypt.

name: Olives_Mount
meaning: A mountain ridge east of Jerusalem
notes: The Mount of Olives is a mountain ridge east of Jerusalem, known as the site of many significant events in the Bible, particularly in the life of Jesus.

name: On
meaning: An ancient Egyptian city, mentioned in relation to Joseph
notes: On, also known as Heliopolis, was an ancient Egyptian city mentioned in the Bible in connection with Joseph's life and prophetic references to Egypt.

name: Ono
meaning: A town in Benjamin, near Lod
notes: Ono was a town in the territory of Benjamin, often mentioned together with Lod, and was the site of a proposed meeting between Nehemiah and his enemies.

name: Ophel
meaning: A fortified area in Jerusalem
notes: Ophel was a fortified area in Jerusalem, located near the temple, and was inhabited by temple servants during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Ophir
meaning: A region known for its gold
notes: Ophir was a region famous for its high-quality gold, which was imported to Israel during the reigns of David and Solomon.

name: Ophni
meaning: A town in Benjamin
notes: Ophni was a town allotted to the tribe of Benjamin during the division of the Promised Land.

name: Ophrah
meaning: A town in Benjamin and a place in Manasseh
notes: Ophrah was a town in Benjamin and a place in Manasseh, associated with Gideon and mentioned in a prophecy of Micah.

name: Ophrah
meaning: Gideon's hometown in Manasseh; a town in Issachar
notes: Ophrah, also known as Hapharaim, was Gideon's hometown in Manasseh and the site of important events during his time as a judge, as well as a town allotted to the tribe of Issachar.

name: Pacatiana
meaning: A place mentioned in some manuscripts of 1 Timothy
notes: Pacatiana is a place mentioned in some manuscripts of 1Ti.6.21 , but its exact location and significance are unknown.

name: Paddan
meaning: The homeland of the patriarchs in Mesopotamia
notes: Paddan, also known as Paddan-aram or Aram, was the homeland of the patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, located in Mesopotamia.

name: Pamphylia
meaning: A Roman province in Asia Minor
notes: Pamphylia was a Roman province on the southern coast of Asia Minor, visited by Paul and Barnabas during their missionary journeys.

name: Paphos
meaning: A city on the island of Cyprus
notes: Paphos was a city on the island of Cyprus, where Paul and Barnabas encountered a sorcerer and converted the proconsul to Christianity.

name: Parah
meaning: A city in Benjamin's territory
notes: Parah was a city allotted to the tribe of Benjamin, located between Avvim and Ophrah.

name: Paran
meaning: A desert region in the Sinai Peninsula
notes: Paran was a desert region in the Sinai Peninsula, associated with the Israelites' wanderings and the early life of Ishmael.

name: Paran_Mount
meaning: A mountain associated with God's appearance
notes: Mount Paran is mentioned in poetic passages as a place from which God comes or shines forth.

name: Parbar
meaning: A colonnade or structure in the temple complex
notes: Parbar was a colonnade or structure located on the west side of the temple complex in Jerusalem.

name: Parvaim
meaning: A place from which Solomon obtained gold
notes: Parvaim was a place or region from which Solomon obtained gold for decorating the temple in Jerusalem.

name: Patara
meaning: A city in Lycia visited by Paul
notes: Patara was a coastal city in Lycia (modern-day Turkey) where Paul changed ships during his journey to Jerusalem.

name: Pathros
meaning: A region in Upper Egypt
notes: Pathros was a region in Upper Egypt (southern Egypt) where some Judeans settled after the Babylonian exile.

name: Patmos
meaning: An island where John received the Revelation
notes: Patmos is a Greek island in the Aegean Sea where the apostle John was exiled and received the visions recorded in the Book of Revelation.

name: Pau
meaning: A city in Edom
notes: Pau, also known as Pai, was a city in Edom mentioned in the genealogy of Edomite kings.

name: Pelusium
meaning: An Egyptian city, also known as Sin
notes: Pelusium, also known as Sin, was an important Egyptian city mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy against Egypt.

name: Peniel
meaning: A place where Jacob wrestled with God
notes: Peniel, also called Penuel, was the place where Jacob wrestled with God and had his name changed to Israel.

name: People's_Gate
meaning: A gate in Jerusalem mentioned by Jeremiah
notes: The People's Gate was one of the gates of Jerusalem, where the prophet Jeremiah was instructed to proclaim God's message.

name: Peor
meaning: A mountain in Moab associated with idolatry
notes: Peor was a mountain in Moab where Balak brought Balaam to curse Israel, and where the Israelites later engaged in idolatry and immorality with the Moabites.

name: Perazim_Mount
meaning: A place where David defeated the Philistines
notes: Mount Perazim was the location where David, with God's help, defeated the Philistines, and it is used by Isaiah as an example of God's judgment.

name: Perez-uzza
meaning: A place named after Uzzah's death
notes: Perez-uzza was the name given to the place where Uzzah died after touching the Ark of the Covenant during its transport to Jerusalem.

name: Perga
meaning: A city in Pamphylia visited by Paul
notes: Perga was a city in Pamphylia (modern-day Turkey) where Paul and Barnabas preached the gospel during their first missionary journey.

name: Pergamum
meaning: A city in Asia Minor with a church
notes: Pergamum was one of the seven churches of Asia addressed in the Book of Revelation, known for its faithfulness despite living in a city associated with Satan's throne.

name: Persia
meaning: An empire that ruled over the exiled Jews
notes: Persia was the empire that conquered Babylon and allowed the exiled Jews to return to Jerusalem and rebuild the temple.

name: Pethor
meaning: The hometown of Balaam in Mesopotamia
notes: Pethor was the hometown of Balaam, the prophet hired by Balak to curse Israel, located near the Euphrates River in Mesopotamia.

name: Pharpar
meaning: A river in Damascus, Syria
notes: Pharpar was one of the rivers of Damascus, mentioned by Naaman the leper when comparing them to the Jordan River in Israel.

name: Philadelphia
meaning: One of the seven churches in Asia Minor
notes: Philadelphia was one of the seven churches in Asia Minor addressed in the Book of Revelation, known for its faithfulness and endurance.

name: Philippi
meaning: A city in Macedonia visited by Paul
notes: Philippi was a city in Macedonia where Paul founded a church and experienced persecution, imprisonment, and a miraculous deliverance.

name: Philistia
meaning: An ancient people and region in Canaan
notes: The Philistines were a powerful people who inhabited the coastal plain of Canaan and were often in conflict with the Israelites during the period of the judges and early monarchy.

name: Phoenicia
meaning: A region and people on the Mediterranean coast
notes: Phoenicia was a region along the Mediterranean coast, north of Israel, known for its maritime trade and mentioned in the New Testament in connection with the spread of the gospel.

name: Phoenix
meaning: A harbor on the island of Crete
notes: Phoenix was a harbor on the island of Crete where the ship carrying Paul and other prisoners attempted to winter during their journey to Rome.

name: Phrygia
meaning: A region in Asia Minor with early Christians
notes: Phrygia was a region in Asia Minor where Paul traveled and preached the gospel, and some of its inhabitants were present in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.

name: Pi-beseth
meaning: An Egyptian city mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy
notes: Pi-beseth was an Egyptian city that Ezekiel prophesied would experience God's judgment along with other cities in Egypt.

name: Pi-hahiroth
meaning: A place near the Red Sea crossing
notes: Pi-hahiroth was a location near the Red Sea where the Israelites camped before crossing the sea during the Exodus from Egypt.

name: Pirathon
meaning: A town in Ephraim, home of several notable Israelites
notes: Pirathon was a town in the hill country of Ephraim, associated with the judge Abdon and two of David's mighty men, Benaiah and Hiddai.

name: Pisgah
meaning: A mountain range in Moab, east of the Jordan
notes: Pisgah, or the slopes of Pisgah, was a mountain range in Moab where Moses viewed the Promised Land before his death.

name: Pishon
meaning: A river flowing from Eden, encircling Havilah
notes: Pishon was one of the four rivers that flowed from the river in the Garden of Eden, encircling the land of Havilah, which was known for its gold, bdellium, and onyx.

name: Pisidia
meaning: A region in Asia Minor visited by Paul
notes: Pisidia was a mountainous region in Asia Minor where Paul and Barnabas preached the gospel during their first missionary journey.

name: Pithom
meaning: A store city built by the Israelites in Egypt
notes: Pithom was one of the store cities built by the Israelites during their enslavement in Egypt, along with Rameses.

name: Pontus
meaning: A region in Asia Minor with Jewish inhabitants
notes: Pontus was a region in Asia Minor along the Black Sea coast, home to Jewish inhabitants and early Christian converts.

name: Potsherd_Gate
meaning: A gate in Jerusalem mentioned by Jeremiah
notes: The Potsherd Gate was a gate in Jerusalem near the Valley of Ben Hinnom, where Jeremiah was instructed to proclaim a message of judgment against Judah.

name: Punon
meaning: A stopping place for the Israelites in the wilderness
notes: Punon was one of the places where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings, located between Zalmonah and Oboth.

name: Puteoli
meaning: A port city in Italy visited by Paul
notes: Puteoli was a major port city in Italy where Paul stayed for seven days on his journey to Rome as a prisoner.

name: Raamah
meaning: A trading partner of Tyre, possibly in Arabia
notes: Raamah was a place, possibly located in Arabia, that traded with the city of Tyre, offering spices, precious stones, and gold.

name: Raamses
meaning: A store city built by the Israelites in Egypt
notes: Raamses was one of the store cities built by the Israelites during their enslavement in Egypt, along with Pithom.

name: Rabbith
meaning: A town allotted to the tribe of Issachar
notes: Rabbith was a town in the territory of Issachar, mentioned in the list of cities and towns allocated to the tribe during the division of the Promised Land.

name: Rakkath
meaning: City on the western shore of the Sea of Galilee
notes: Tiberias (Rakkath), a city on the western shore of the Sea of Galilee, near where Jesus fed the five thousand ( Josh. 19:35; Jhn.6.23 ).

name: Rakkon
meaning: A town allotted to the tribe of Dan
notes: Rakkon was a town mentioned in the description of the territory allocated to the tribe of Dan in the Promised Land.

name: Ramah
meaning: A town in Benjamin, near Gibeah and Jerusalem
notes: Ramah was a town in the territory of Benjamin, often associated with significant events in Israel's history, such as the mourning of Rachel and the imprisonment of Jeremiah.

name: Ramah
meaning: A town on the border of Asher and Tyre
notes: Ramah was a town located on the border between the territory of Asher and the city-state of Tyre.

name: Ramah
meaning: A fortified city in the territory of Naphtali
notes: Ramah was a fortified city located in the territory of Naphtali, mentioned in the list of cities allocated to the tribe during the division of the Promised Land.

name: Ramath-lehi
meaning: The place where Samson killed a thousand Philistines
notes: Ramath-lehi, meaning "hill of the jawbone," was the place where Samson killed a thousand Philistines with the jawbone of a donkey.

name: Rameses
meaning: Egyptian city where Israelites lived before the Exodus
notes: Rameses was a city in Egypt where the Israelites lived during their enslavement before the Exodus ( Gen. 47:11; Exo. 12:37 ).

name: Ramoth
meaning: City of refuge east of the Jordan
notes: Ramoth, also called Ramoth-gilead, was a city of refuge in Gad and a Levitical city ( Deu. 4:43; Jos. 20:8; 21:38 ).

name: Recah
meaning: Descendant of Judah
notes: Recah was a descendant of Judah through Caleb ( 1Ch. 4:12 ).

name: Red_Sea
meaning: Sea crossed by Israelites in the Exodus
notes: The Red Sea was the body of water miraculously crossed by the Israelites in their escape from Egypt ( Exo. 13:18; 15:4 ).

name: Rehob
meaning: City on the border of Asher
notes: Rehob was a city on the northern border of the territory allotted to the tribe of Asher ( Jos. 19:28 ).

name: Rehob
meaning: Levitical city in Asher
notes: Rehob was a Levitical city within the territory of Asher ( Jos. 19:30; 21:31; 1Ch. 6:75 ).

name: Rehoboth
meaning: Well dug by Isaac
notes: Rehoboth was the name of a well dug by Isaac where he found room and water ( Gen. 26:22 ).

name: Rehoboth
meaning: City associated with an Edomite king
notes: Rehoboth was a city associated with Shaul, an Edomite king ( Gen. 36:37; 1Ch. 1:48 ).

name: Rekem
meaning: City in Benjamin
notes: Rekem was a city allotted to the tribe of Benjamin ( Jos. 18:27 ).

name: Remeth
meaning: Levitical city in Issachar
notes: Remeth, also called Ramoth, was a Levitical city allotted to the tribe of Issachar ( Jos. 19:21; 1Ch. 6:73 ).

name: Rephaim_Valley
meaning: Valley near Jerusalem, site of battles
notes: The Valley of Rephaim was a valley near Jerusalem where David fought the Philistines ( 2Sa. 5:18, 22; 23:13; 1Ch. 11:15; 14:9 ).

name: Rephidim
meaning: Israelite encampment during the Exodus
notes: Rephidim was a place where the Israelites camped during their journey from Egypt to Sinai ( Exo. 17:1, 8; 19:2; Num. 33:14, 15 ).

name: Resen
meaning: Ancient Assyrian city built by Nimrod
notes: Resen was an ancient Assyrian city built by Nimrod between Nineveh and Calah ( Gen. 10:12 ).

name: Rezeph
meaning: City conquered by the Assyrians
notes: Rezeph was a city conquered by the Assyrians, mentioned in a letter from the Assyrian king to Hezekiah ( 2Ki. 19:12; Isa. 37:12 ).

name: Rhegium
meaning: Italian city visited by Paul
notes: Rhegium was a city in Italy where Paul's ship stopped on his journey to Rome ( Act. 28:13 ).

name: Rhodes
meaning: Island visited by Paul on his journey
notes: Rhodes was an island where Paul stopped during his journey to Jerusalem ( Act. 21:1 ).

name: Riblah
meaning: Babylonian headquarters during the conquest of Judah
notes: Riblah was a city in Hamath where the Babylonians set up their headquarters during their campaigns against Judah ( 2Ki. 23:33; 25:6, 20-21; Jer. 39:5-6; 52:9-10, 26-27 ).

name: Riblah
meaning: Place on the eastern border of the Promised Land
notes: Riblah was a place mentioned in the description of the eastern border of the Promised Land ( Num. 34:11 ).

name: Rimmon
meaning: Rock where Benjamites fled after battle
notes: Rimmon was a rock where 600 Benjamite survivors fled after a battle with the other Israelite tribes ( Jdg. 20:45, 47; 21:13 ).

name: Rimmon
meaning: A town in Judah and Simeon
notes: Rimmon, a town allotted to Judah and later given to Simeon, was located in the Negev region.

name: Rimmon-perez
meaning: Israelite encampment during the Exodus
notes: Rimmon-perez was a place where the Israelites camped during their journey from Egypt to Canaan ( Num. 33:19-20 ).

name: Rissah
meaning: Israelite encampment during the Exodus
notes: Rissah was a place where the Israelites camped during their journey from Egypt to Canaan ( Num. 33:21-22 ).

name: Rithmah
meaning: Israelite encampment during the Exodus
notes: Rithmah was a place where the Israelites camped during their journey from Egypt to Canaan ( Num. 33:18-19 ).

name: Rock_of_Escape
meaning: Place where Saul stopped pursuing David
notes: The Rock of Escape was a place where Saul stopped pursuing David after being called away to fight the Philistines ( 1Sa. 23:28 ).

name: Rogelim
meaning: Hometown of Barzillai the Gileadite
notes: Rogelim was the hometown of Barzillai the Gileadite, who provided supplies for David during Absalom's rebellion ( 2Sa. 17:27; 19:31 ).

name: Rome
meaning: Capital city of the Roman Empire
notes: Rome was the capital of the Roman Empire, where Paul was imprisoned and wrote several epistles ( Act.28.16; Rom. 1:7 ).

name: Sahar
meaning: Unknown location mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy
notes: Sahar is a place mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy, but its exact location is unknown ( Ezk. 27:18 ).

name: Salamis
meaning: City on Cyprus visited by Paul and Barnabas
notes: Salamis was a city on the island of Cyprus where Paul and Barnabas preached the gospel in the Jewish synagogues ( Act.13.5 ).

name: Salecah
meaning: City in Bashan, east of the Jordan River
notes: Salecah was a city in the region of Bashan, east of the Jordan River, associated with the kingdoms of Og and Sihon ( Deut. 3:10; Josh. 12:5; 13:11; 1Chr. 5:11 ).

name: Salim
meaning: Place near Aenon where John the Baptist baptized
notes: Salim was a place near Aenon where John the Baptist was baptizing, because there was plenty of water there ( Jhn.3.23 ).

name: Salmone
meaning: Promontory on the island of Crete
notes: Salmone was a promontory on the island of Crete that Paul's ship passed on his voyage to Rome ( Act.27.7 ).

name: Salt_Sea
meaning: Another name for the Dead Sea
notes: The Salt Sea, also known as the Sea of Arabah, is another name for the Dead Sea, located at the lowest point on Earth ( Gen. 14:3; Num. 34:3, 12; Deut. 3:17; Josh. 3:16; 12:3; 15:2, 5; 18:19; Deut. 4:49; 2Ki. 14:25 ).

name: Salt_Valley
meaning: Valley where David and his commanders defeated enemies
notes: The Salt Valley was a location where David and his commanders defeated the Edomites and Arameans ( 2Sa. 8:13; 2Ki. 14:7; 1Chr. 18:12; 2Chr. 25:11; Psa. 60:1 ).

name: Samaria
meaning: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants
notes: Samaria was the capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel, and its inhabitants were known as Samaritans ( 1Ki. 16:24; 2Ki. 17:24; Jhn. 4:9; Act.8.5 ).

name: Samos
meaning: Island visited by Paul during his travels
notes: Samos is an island in the Aegean Sea where Paul stopped during his third missionary journey ( Act.20.15 ).

name: Samothrace
meaning: Island visited by Paul during his second missionary journey
notes: Samothrace is an island in the Aegean Sea where Paul and his companions landed during his second missionary journey ( Act.16.11 ).

name: Sansannah
meaning: Town in the Negev region of Judah
notes: Sansannah was a town allotted to the tribe of Judah in the Negev region ( Josh. 15:31 ).

name: Sarid
meaning: Border town of Zebulun's territory
notes: Sarid was a border town in the territory allotted to the tribe of Zebulun ( Josh. 19:10, 12 ).

name: Seba
meaning: Kingdom mentioned in prophetic and poetic texts
notes: Seba was a kingdom mentioned in prophetic and poetic texts, often in the context of bringing gifts to God ( Psa. 72:10; Isa. 43:3 ).

name: Sebam
meaning: Town in the territory of Reuben
notes: Sebam was one of the towns in the territory of Reuben, east of the Jordan River ( Num. 32:3 ).

name: Secacah
meaning: Town in the wilderness of Judah
notes: Secacah was a town located in the wilderness region of Judah ( Josh. 15:61 ).

name: Second_Quarter
meaning: District in Jerusalem mentioned by Huldah and Zephaniah
notes: The Second Quarter was a district in Jerusalem mentioned in connection with the prophetess Huldah ( 2Ki. 22:14; 2Chr. 34:22 ) and in Zephaniah's prophecy ( Zeph. 1:10 ).

name: Secu
meaning: Place near Ramah visited by Saul
notes: Secu was a place near Ramah where Saul went in search of David ( 1Sam. 19:22 ).

name: Seir
meaning: Region inhabited by Edomites, descendants of Esau
notes: Seir was a mountainous region inhabited by the Edomites, the descendants of Esau ( Gen. 32:3; 36:8; Num. 24:18; Deut. 2:4; Josh. 24:4 ).

name: Seir_Mount
meaning: Mountainous region in Seir, associated with Edom
notes: Mount Seir refers to the mountainous region within Seir, often associated with the Edomites ( Deut. 1:2; 2:1, 5; 1Chr. 4:42; Ezek. 35:2, 3, 7, 15 ).

name: Seir_Mount
meaning: Landmark on the boundary of Judah
notes: Mount Seir was a landmark on the boundary of Judah, near Kiriath-jearim and Chesalon ( Josh. 15:10 ).

name: Seirah
meaning: Place where Ehud escaped after killing Eglon
notes: Seirah was the place to which Ehud escaped after killing Eglon, the king of Moab ( Judg. 3:26 ).

name: Sela
meaning: Edomite stronghold captured by King Amaziah of Judah
notes: Sela, also known as rock or Joktheel, was an Edomite stronghold captured by King Amaziah of Judah ( 2Ki. 14:7; 2Chr. 25:12; Isa. 16:1; 42:11; Judg. 1:36 ).

name: Seleucia
meaning: Port city from which Paul and Barnabas sailed
notes: Seleucia was the port city from which Paul and Barnabas sailed to Cyprus on their first missionary journey ( Act.13.4 ).

name: Seneh
meaning: Rocky crag near Michmash
notes: Seneh was one of two rocky crags between which Jonathan and his armor-bearer passed to attack the Philistine garrison at Michmash ( 1Sam. 14:4 ).

name: Sephar
meaning: Boundary of the territory settled by Joktan's descendants
notes: Sephar was a mountain in the east that marked the boundary of the territory settled by the descendants of Joktan ( Gen. 10:30 ).

name: Sepharad
meaning: City in Asia Minor; destination of exiled Jews
notes: Sepharad, possibly referring to Sardis, was a destination of exiled Jews ( Obad. 1:20 ) and one of the seven churches mentioned in Revelation ( Rev. 1:11; 3:1, 4 ).

name: Sepharvaim
meaning: City of origin for people resettled in Samaria
notes: Sepharvaim was one of the cities from which the Assyrians brought people to resettle in Samaria after the deportation of the Israelites ( 2Ki. 17:24, 31; 18:34; 19:13; Isa. 36:19; 37:13 ).

name: Shaalbim
meaning: Town in Dan, home of David's mighty men
notes: Shaalbim, also called Shaalabbin, was a town allotted to the tribe of Dan ( Josh. 19:42; Judg. 1:35 ) and the hometown of some of David's mighty men ( 2Sam. 23:32; 1Chr. 11:33 ). It was also a town under Solomon's administration ( 1Ki. 4:9 ).

name: Shaalim
meaning: Region traversed by Saul in search of donkeys
notes: Shaalim was a region through which Saul passed while searching for his father's lost donkeys ( 1Sam. 9:4 ).

name: Shaaraim
meaning: Town in Judah; site of Philistine retreat
notes: Shaaraim was a town in the Shephelah of Judah ( Josh. 15:36 ) and a place the Philistines passed in their retreat from Socoh ( 1Sam. 17:52 ).

name: Shahazumah
meaning: Border town of Issachar
notes: Shahazumah was a town on the border of Issachar's territory ( Josh. 19:22 ).

name: Shalishah
meaning: Region Saul passed through seeking donkeys
notes: Shalishah was a region Saul and his servant passed through while searching for his father's lost donkeys ( 1Sam. 9:4 ).

name: Shallecheth
meaning: Gate in Jerusalem assigned to Shuppim and Hosah
notes: Shallecheth was a gate in Jerusalem assigned to the Levites Shuppim and Hosah for guard duty ( 1Chr. 26:16 ).

name: Shamir
meaning: Issacharite judge who led Israel for 23 years
notes: Shamir, from the hill country of Ephraim, was an Issacharite who judged Israel for 23 years ( Judg. 10:1-2 ).

name: Shamir
meaning: Town in the hill country of Judah
notes: Shamir was a town in the hill country of Judah ( Josh. 15:48 ).

name: Shaphir
meaning: Town addressed in Micah's prophecy
notes: Shaphir was a town mentioned in Micah's prophecy, urged to pass on in nakedness and shame ( Mic. 1:11 ).

name: Sharon
meaning: Coastal plain known for its beauty and fertility
notes: Sharon was a coastal plain known for its beauty, fertility, and pastureland ( 1Chr. 27:29; Sng.2.1; Isa. 33:9; 35:2; 65:10; Act.9.35 ).

name: Sharon
meaning: Region where Gadites pastured their flocks
notes: Sharon was a region east of the Jordan where the Gadites pastured their flocks ( 1Chr. 5:16 ).

name: Sharuhen
meaning: Town allotted to Simeon within Judah's territory
notes: Sharuhen, also called Shaaraim or Shilhim, was a town allotted to the tribe of Simeon within Judah's territory ( Josh. 19:6; 1Chr. 4:31; Josh. 15:32 ).

name: Shaveh
meaning: Valley where Chedorlaomer defeated the Emites
notes: Shaveh Kiriathaim was a valley where Chedorlaomer and his allies defeated the Emites before battling the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah ( Gen. 14:5, 17 ).

name: Sheba
meaning: Kingdom known for wealth, trade, and the Queen of Sheba
notes: Sheba, also referred to as the South, was a kingdom known for its wealth, trade, and the visit of its queen to King Solomon ( 1Ki. 10:1-13; 2Chr. 9:1-12; Ps. 72:10, 15; Isa. 60:6; Jer. 6:20; Ezek. 27:22-23; 38:13; Luke 11:31 ).

name: Shebarim
meaning: Place near Ai where Israelites fled
notes: Shebarim was a place near Ai where the Israelites fled after being defeated due to Achan's sin ( Josh. 7:5 ).

name: Shechem
meaning: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim
notes: Shechem was a prominent city in Canaan, later allotted to the tribe of Ephraim, and the site of important events in Israel's history ( Gen. 12:6; 33:18-20; Josh. 20:7; 24:1, 25-26; Judg. 9; 1Ki. 12:1, 25; Ps. 60:6; 108:7; Act.7.16 ).

name: Sheep_Gate
meaning: Gate in Jerusalem near the sheep market
notes: The Sheep Gate was a gate in Jerusalem's wall, likely near the sheep market, that was rebuilt during Nehemiah's time ( Neh. 3:1, 32; 12:39; Jhn.5.2 ).

name: Shelah
meaning: Pool and tunnel in Jerusalem
notes: Shelah, also called Shiloah, the King's Pool, or Siloam, was a pool in Jerusalem fed by the Gihon Spring via Hezekiah's Tunnel ( Neh. 3:15; Isa. 8:6; Neh. 2:14; Luke 13:4; Jhn.9.7, 11 ).

name: Shema
meaning: Town in the Negev region of Judah
notes: Shema was a town in the Negev region of Judah ( Josh. 15:26 ).

name: Shen
meaning: Place where Samuel set up the Ebenezer stone
notes: Shen was the place where Samuel set up the Ebenezer stone to commemorate the Israelites' victory over the Philistines ( 1Sam. 7:12 ).

name: Shepham
meaning: Landmark on the northeastern border of the Promised Land
notes: Shepham was a landmark on the northeastern border of the Promised Land, between Hazar-enan and Riblah ( Num. 34:10-11 ).

name: Shephelah
meaning: Lowland region between Judean hills and coastal plain
notes: The Shephelah was the lowland region between the Judean hills and the coastal plain, known for its fertile valleys and strategic importance ( Josh. 9:1; 10:40; 2Chr. 28:18; Jer. 17:26; 32:44; 33:13 ).

name: Shepher_Mount
meaning: Campsite during Israel's wilderness wanderings
notes: Mount Shepher was a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings between Kehelathah and Haradah ( Num. 33:23-24 ).

name: Shihor-libnath
meaning: Boundary point of Asher's territory
notes: Shihor-libnath was a place that marked the boundary of the territory allotted to the tribe of Asher ( Josh. 19:26 ).

name: Shikkeron
meaning: Town on the border of Judah
notes: Shikkeron was a town on the northern border of Judah's territory, near Mount Baalah ( Josh. 15:11 ).

name: Shiloh
meaning: Israelite sanctuary and assembly point during the judges' period
notes: Shiloh was an important Israelite sanctuary and assembly point during the period of the judges, where the tabernacle was set up and the land was allotted to the tribes ( Josh. 18:1, 8-10; 1Sam. 1:3, 9, 24; 2:14; 3:21; Jer. 7:12, 14 ).

name: Shimron
meaning: Canaanite city conquered by Joshua, allotted to Zebulun
notes: Shimron, also called Shimron-meron, was a Canaanite city conquered by Joshua ( Josh. 11:1; 12:20 ) and later allotted to the tribe of Zebulun ( Josh. 19:15 ).

name: Shion
meaning: Town in the territory of Issachar
notes: Shion was a town allotted to the tribe of Issachar, mentioned along with Shunem, Hapharaim, and Anaharath ( Josh. 19:19 ).

name: Shittim
meaning: The last Israelite campsite before crossing the Jordan.
notes: Shittim, also called Abel-shittim, the final Israelite encampment before entering Canaan.

name: Shittim_Valley
meaning: Valley mentioned in Joel's prophecy
notes: The Shittim Valley is mentioned in Joel's prophecy as a place where water will flow when God restores Judah's fortunes ( Jol.3.18 ).

name: Shoa
meaning: People group mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy
notes: Shoa was a people group mentioned along with the Babylonians, Chaldeans, and Assyrians in Ezekiel's prophecy against Jerusalem ( Ezek. 23:23 ).

name: Shual
meaning: Region raided by Philistines during Saul's reign
notes: Shual was a region raided by Philistine raiders during Saul's reign, along with Ophrah and the land of Shaalim ( 1Sam. 13:17 ).

name: Shunem
meaning: Town in Issachar; home of the Shunammite woman
notes: Shunem was a town allotted to the tribe of Issachar ( Josh. 19:18 ), known for being the home of the Shunammite woman who hosted Elisha ( 2Ki. 4:8 ) and where the Philistines camped before battling Saul ( 1Sam. 28:4 ).

name: Shur
meaning: Wilderness area between Canaan and Egypt
notes: Shur was a wilderness area between Canaan and Egypt, mentioned in connection with Hagar ( Gen. 16:7 ), Abraham ( Gen. 20:1; 25:18 ), the Israelites' wanderings ( Exod. 15:22 ), and Saul's battles ( 1Sam. 15:7; 27:8 ).

name: Sibmah
meaning: Moabite town known for its vineyards
notes: Sibmah was a Moabite town known for its vineyards, allotted to the tribe of Reuben ( Num. 32:38; Josh. 13:19 ) and later mentioned in prophecies concerning Moab ( Isa. 16:8-9; Jer. 48:32 ).
